Push notifications to your users' devices: send one, see how it went, set up push services.

Usage:
  voidhash push <command> [flags]

Commands:
  send        Send a push notification to people's devices.
  list        List the latest push notifications with how many devices each reached, failed or
              skipped.
  deliveries  Show how a push notification reached each device, and why deliveries failed.
  config      The push services the project sends through (APNs, FCM): list, set up, turn on or off,
              delete.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash push <command> --help' for more about a command.
